ItemID: 1; Title: Digital Caliper, 0-6" Electronic Caliper Auto - Off Feature with Large LCD Screen Vernier Caliper Conversion Measuring Tool for Length Depth Inner Outer Diameter Measuring; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to measure screw diameters and washer sizes for my recent hardware purchases.
ItemID: 2; Title: Gorilla Black Duct Tape, 1.88" x 35 yd, Black, (Bulk Pack of 18); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for occasional repairs, but I would skip an eighteen-roll pack without a specific need.
ItemID: 3; Title: 560PCS Heat Shrink Tubing 2:1, Eventronic Electrical Wire Cable Wrap Assortment Electric Insulation Heat Shrink Tube Kit with Box(5 colors/12 Sizes); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am buying fastening and hanging supplies, with no current wire repair project.
ItemID: 4; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a broken metal part that needs an epoxy repair.
ItemID: 5; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Midnight Purple PETG 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current 3D printing need to justify buying filament.
ItemID: 6; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not help with the fastening or magnetic hanging supplies I am currently using.
ItemID: 7; Title: Etekcity Infrared Thermometer 1080, Heat Temperature Temp Gun for Cooking, Laser IR Surface Tool for Pizza Oven, Meat, Griddle, Grill, HVAC, Engine, Accessories, -58°F to 1130°F, Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no temperature measurement task right now, so I would pass.
ItemID: 8; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying small fasteners does not mean I need to cut metal, and I have no current cutting project.
ItemID: 9; Title: Gorilla 2 Part Epoxy, 5 Minute Set, .85 Ounce Syringe, Clear, (Pack of 1); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current mounting needs use removable hooks and screws, so I do not need a permanent adhesive.
ItemID: 10; Title: Super Glue 15187 , Clear- pack of 12; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no immediate gluing task and would not buy twelve tubes just to keep around.
